name: 패밀리 포켓몬 카드 게임
englishName: Sword & Shield Family Pokémon Card Game

description.text: Sword & Shield Family Pokémon Card Game, released in Korean on 27 November 2021: three 60-card decks, Cinderace V, Pikachu V and Tyranitar V, a board playmat, damage counters and a case for them, two battle guides, a how-to-play guide, a rule book, a match sheet, a card box and three paper deck cases.
